# tiny-chess-01
> Tournament-grade deterministic UCI chess engine in Python 3.13 stdlib (<4 KB) for make.fun tiny-chess-01 ($500 USDC).

- Entry: `main.py` (3,780 bytes)
- Python: 3.13 stdlib (`os`, `sys`, `json`, `urllib.request`)
- Board: 10x12 rotated mailbox (180° flip)
- Search: MTD-bi Negascout + Quiescence + NMP (R=2) + LMR
- Eval: Procedural PeSTO center distance + tapered King endgame
- Budget: 8,000 nodes/move fixed limit (zero clocks)
- Bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/tiny-chess-01
- Repo: https://github.com/Akash1070/tiny-chess-01.git
- Payout: `FkoaEHrqcKmCUjis98bYo7C7wcSgJZ7p8KXifpbLum9j`
